messages.author: 353633d328a1858e
messages.subject: Adding Data Labels to a scatterplot using qplot
parts:
Hello All,

Is there an option to have the labels for each data-point in my data
frame be displayed in a scatterplot I created using qplot.
The scatterplot works fine.

I am stuck on which option to include with "qplot" so that the point
labels show up.

Many thanks,
Santosh

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: Adding Data Labels to a scatterplot using qplot
parts:
ggplot(data=data, aes(x=x, y=y, label=label))+geom_point()+geom_text()

That's how I'd do it.  

Brandon
